subject: Observability add-ons pricing — retention + tracing + dashboards (proposal update)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Morgan <claire@clearwavehealth.com>
Cc: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-04-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Observability add-ons pricing — retention + tracing + dashboards (proposal)

Hi Claire,

Thanks for taking the call earlier — good to hear more about ClearWave's telemetry needs. As discussed, I've attached a proposal that maps your usage profile (90-day retention, high trace cardinality on peak days) to two commercial options:

1) Retain+Tracing Pack (recommended): 90d retention, sampling + storage, 24/7 trace ingest pipeline, advanced dashboards pre-bundled — monthly slab pricing.
2) PayGo Observability: metered retention and trace egress, lower base fee, higher per-GB costs — better if usage is spiky and you want to avoid long commitments.

Key ask: I wanted to get feedback on which commitment horizon you prefer (12m vs 24m) so I can run a discount scenario.

Attachments: ClearWave-obs-proposal-v1.pdf (proposal + sample invoice)

Next steps: if you can confirm target retention and an expected monthly TB number for traces, I’ll send a tailored quote and an example SOW.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
m: (415) 555-0119
From: Claire Morgan <claire@clearwavehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-02T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons pricing — retention + tracing + dashboards (proposal)

Marissa —

Thanks for the proposal. A few clarifying points before we move to a formal quote:
- We expect ~3.5TB of trace data per month on average, but during campaign spikes that can double.
- 90-day retention is a hard requirement for compliance.
- Advanced dashboards are a nice-to-have; the priority is reliable trace ingest and retention.

Question on discounts: your proposal looks reasonable but puts us over our planned budget for Year 1. Is there room for an introductory concession (either a smaller % discount or crediting for month 1) if we commit to a 12-month contract? Also need a clear migration SOW and who will own the initial tracing instrumentation work.

Cc'ing procurement@clearwavehealth.com for visibility.

—Claire
Claire Morgan | Head of Observability, ClearWave Health
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-02T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Observability add-ons pricing — request for concession (ClearWave)

Team — forwarding Claire's note. ClearWave is firm on 90d retention and expects 3.5TB/month baseline with spikes to ~7TB. They asked for an introductory concession if they sign a 12m.

Notes / asks:
- Can we afford a 12-month concession? Their ARR would land in the mid-six-figures if they go with the Retain+Tracing Pack.
- Laura: can we model a concession that preserves margin (e.g., smaller % off list, or crediting first 30 days of retention storage)?
- Ben: any flexibility on bundling advanced dashboards in Year 1 as a service credit rather than a line-item license? That helps them adopt faster.

I attached the original proposal. I'll wait for a recommended concession path before replying to procurement.

Thanks,
Marissa
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-03T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Observability add-ons pricing — request for concession (ClearWave)

Marissa / Laura —

I ran the numbers and here is a concede path that keeps unit economics acceptable while giving ClearWave a palpable win:

Offer A (preferred): 12-month commitment, Retain+Tracing Pack
- 15% off list price for Year 1 (applied to retention and tracing slab components).
- First 30 days of retention storage credited (applies on onboarding invoice).
- Advanced dashboards included as a free add-on for the first 6 months (technical onboarding included).
- Standard support; Advanced Support is an add-on.

Offer B (lower risk): 12-month commitment, PayGo Observability
- 10% credit on first two months of ingestion fees (to smooth spike risk).
- Guaranteed rate cap for per-GB egress (protects them on spikes).

Commercial caveats: concessions contingent on signed SOW within 45 days and a 30% upfront payment. Legal to sign standard MSA/SOW; pricing concession must be noted in an appendix.

I attached an internal workbook: obs-concession-math.xlsx showing margin impact and break-even. If legal needs to tweak SLA language for retention, route through Laura.

If you think we should push to 18m to deepen discount, tell me — but we can start here.

—Ben
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Morgan <claire@clearwavehealth.com>, procurement@clearwavehealth.com

Date: 2028-04-04T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons pricing — retention + tracing + dashboards (proposal update)

Claire / Procurement team —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Based on internal review, we can offer the following commercial path if ClearWave signs a 12-month SOW:

Recommended commercial: Retain+Tracing Pack (12m)
- 15% discount on the retention & tracing slab for Year 1
- First 30 days of retention storage credited at invoice (onboarding credit)
- Advanced dashboards included at no charge for the first 6 months (we'll include onboarding hours to get dashboards production-ready)
- Standard support included; option to upgrade to Premium Support for 18% of the adjusted monthly fee.
- Concession contingent on 30% upfront payment and signed SOW within 45 days.

Operational notes: Evelyn will own the onboarding SOW (instrumentation scope + migration runbook). We will provide a draft SOW and migration milestone plan within 3 business days for your review. Laura, please keep legal in the loop for appendix language on retention SLAs.
